story.situation: A 240-unit apartment portfolio with a two-person office. Tenant emails and texts pile up; simple questions wait days and an urgent leak can sit unread overnight.
story.constraints: Emergencies must reach a human in minutes, not wait for the agent's judgement on spend. Answers must cite the lease or FAQ so staff can stand behind them. Any vendor spend over the limit needs a manager's click; the agent never spends on its own above it.
story.replay: Reuse: classify -> agent with narrow tools -> human approval over a threshold fits any service inbox (IT helpdesk, facilities, field service). Next time: connect the real work-order API first, and log every tool call so the owner can audit what the agent did overnight.

metrics.emergencies_routed: 2/2 paged within 1 min (before: 37.2 h worst case)
